digest.component_or_area: autodeploy script and review drain system
propositions: AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT firings on 2026-08-12 exceeded DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX by 10–130 seconds (deferred_for values: 1810s, 1820s, 1810s, 1930s vs. 1800s bound), killing in-flight LLM-Review processes during a 60+-merge landing burst.
DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX default value must be raised from 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to absorb observed overshoots.
The pinned test relationship in test_autodeploy_review_drain.py must be tightened from >= 1x to >= 2x DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to enforce the new bound ratio and prevent drift.
The stale 1800s figure in monitoring_autodeploy.tf cadence comment must be updated to 2400s to reflect the new deferral bound.
The 2400s raise absorbs the 2026-08-12 overshoots but does not address saturated episodes where in_flight never reaches zero, which remains a potential residual defect.
